title: Fingerprint
description: Complete immutable input fingerprint for a reproducible execution.

productVersion.description: Version of the product that requested the evaluation.

engineVersion.description: Version of the engine that produced the Result.

scenarioSchemaVersion.description: Version of the Scenario contract consumed by the engine.

catalogHash.description: Content hash of the CatalogSnapshot used for evaluation.

rulesetHash.description: Content hash of the Ruleset used for evaluation.

scenarioHash.description: Content hash of the Scenario used for evaluation.

seed.description: Non-negative deterministic random seed used for evaluation.

resultHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical Fingerprint object excluding this resultHash field.
